summary: 45-year-old man fell into a canyon near the upper Liberty Cap Trail, Colorado National Monument; called 911 around 8:30 p.m.; located with help of his reflective gear and strobe light ~2 a.m. April 22; serious injuries, flown to hospital by CareFlight.
location: Upper Liberty Cap Trail, Colorado National Monument
responding_agency: Mesa County SO; Mesa County SAR Ground/Technical/Comms teams; NPS Rangers; CareFlight
